headline: Executive session on cybersecurity and the deployment of security personnel or devices.
summary: The committee will meet in executive session to discuss security staffing, devices, and strategies. The session is not televised or recorded, and open session resumes afterward.
items: Executive session under M.G.L. c. 30A, Section 1(a)(4)
Discussion of deployment of security personnel or devices, or strategies related to them
location: Media Center, Methuen High School, 1 Ranger Road, Methuen, MA
